value.data: The nearest operational metro station is Central Silk Board (Yellow Line), approximately 1.52 km away. The Sarjapur-Hebbal metro line (Red Line, Phase 3A) is under construction and will have stations within Koramangala, expected to be ready by December 2030.
Daily commutes in Koramangala are often characterized by significant congestion, with a 10 km journey sometimes taking up to two hours during peak hours.

The Sarjapur-Hebbal metro line (Red Line, Phase 3A) is a major upcoming project that will enhance connectivity. Additionally, road-widening projects and urban planning initiatives are continuously being undertaken to improve infrastructure and reduce congestion.

Koramangala is an upscale and lively residential area in Bengaluru, offering a blend of urban amenities, excellent connectivity to business hubs, and a robust social infrastructure. It is a highly desirable neighborhood known for its green spaces, diverse dining, and entertainment options, making it suitable for young professionals, entrepreneurs, and families.
Cosmopolitan, youthful, energetic, vibrant, and a melting pot of cultures.
Koramangala has experienced severe waterlogging incidents, including widespread flooding in September 2022 and May 2025, and knee-deep water in Koramangala 6th Block in April 2020.
